title: The Muster
subtitle: Five hundred of damage, counted by the scoreboard
description: The season opens at the muster stone, where the valley's hunters
have always settled the question of readiness with arithmetic.
A stat task reads a vanilla statistic -- here, five hundred damage
dealt, from `minecraft:damage_dealt` -- and counts it the way an
item task counts items: by the server's tick, with nothing handed
in. The statistics are the game's own ledger; this is the field
